Which sources go with which beliefs

Pick an outcome and all seven news-source regimes are ranked against each other on it, adjusted for party, education, income, age, gender, wave and four standing conspiracy questions. These are associations, not effects: people choose their sources.
Aggregated estimates from the Civic Health and Institutions Project (CHIP50), June 2022 – May 2026.

Open a regime to check its individual channels. Regime and channel estimates come from two separate models.

Forest plots
Subgroup

Click any cell. The top-left cell is every respondent; the top row holds the diploma divide on its own, the left column party on its own, and the interior cells cross the two. Leaners fold into the party they lean toward. Each cell is its own fitted model rather than an interaction term, and the variables defining it leave the control set inside it. Cells thin out toward the bottom right — the count is on every cell, so check it before reading much into one.
